findings.finding: Fixed sitting accent yaw -PI/2 points local -Z toward +X; all nine candidate centres lie east of original coffee-table centre, so every current candidate faces away from the conversation target.
findings.required: Derive each yaw from the approved conversation point using the final asset's measured forward direction. Verify actual geometry and world matrix, not yaw alone.

findings.finding: Six dining chair yaw values face their respective table axes correctly in source; physical visual front/back after fitting still requires independent renders and world-transform tests.
findings.required: Verify backrest behind seat, front points toward assigned table edge, alignment >=0.999, table centre lies forward, no mirrored/reflected transform; repeat on both LODs and installed geometry.

findings.finding: Current dining +Z row centres at z=-0.60; fitted depth extends about 0.038 m beyond provisional z=-0.38 edge. East end chair is close to source wall plane x≈116.911. Provisional edges are not certified walls.
findings.required: Measure actual free floor and wall/door sweep; solve table group position and seating pull-out, do not clip or force a clearance value.

findings.finding: Original coffee table AABB overlaps the second source sofa AABB. AABB overlap is conservative, not proof of triangle penetration; original coffee table is still enhanced with overlay rather than replaced in Stage 4.
findings.required: Independently model distinct p14 sofas and paired p15 tables; compute new collision footprints, reject intersection and measure gap.

findings.finding: Existing furniture catalogue contains curved sofa, rest-chaise, curved dining chair and other assets, but existence does not establish reference match or installed usage.
findings.required: Compare source photographs and independent actual model renders in next stages.
